plugins.name: usage-pacer
plugins.description: Pace your Claude usage so you never run out of limits. Tracks the 5-hour (5h) and weekly (1w) windows against a linear budget toward a cap you set (default 90%): a colored bar above the prompt, a badge in the session title and a status-line entry go green on pace and yellow, orange, red as you run ahead, with a warning before the cap. Everything is configured with /budget.
